description: InventoryDelta is a lightweight, modular system for defining and applying 'localized inventory-state transformations (i.e Deltas)' within Minecraft.

mods.name: InventoryDelta
mods.description: InventoryDelta applies focused Deltas (e.g., AutoCraftSlot Delta, AutoTradeSlot Delta, AutoSmeltSlot Delta) using a consistent naming approach for inventory transformations.

releases.notes:
# Release Difference Receipt

## Overview
- Added focused Deltas for trading, crafting, and smelting refills to streamline inventory flow.
- Introduced configurable AutoSmelt profiles with UI for per-smelter recipe and fuel selection.
- Wired Mod Menu and keybind access plus JSON-backed settings to make Deltas toggleable in game.

## Key Changes
- TransferSlotRefill Delta - `src/main/kotlin/inventorydelta/delta/transfer/TransferSlotRefillDelta.kt` `src/main/java/inventorydelta/mixin/trade/TradeOutputSlotMixin.java`: After trades, refills villager input slots from the player inventory when matching stacks exist.
- AutoCraftSlot Delta - `src/main/kotlin/inventorydelta/delta/craft/AutoCraftSlotDelta.kt` `src/main/java/inventorydelta/mixin/crafting/CraftingResultSlotMixin.java`: Snapshots crafting inputs and restocks the grid after a craft while honoring mismatched manual placements.
- AutoSmeltSlot Delta - `src/main/kotlin/inventorydelta/delta/smelt/AutoSmeltSlotDelta.kt` `src/main/java/inventorydelta/mixin/smelting/FurnaceScreenHandlerMixin.java` `src/main/java/inventorydelta/mixin/smelting/BlastFurnaceScreenHandlerMixin.java` `src/main/java/inventorydelta/mixin/smelting/SmokerScreenHandlerMixin.java`: On smelter open, fills recipe and fuel slots from configured templates per smelter type when matching items are in the inventory.
- Settings and config UX - `src/main/kotlin/inventorydelta/ui/SettingsScreenFactory.kt` `src/main/kotlin/inventorydelta/ui/SmeltDefinitionPickerScreen.kt` `src/main/kotlin/inventorydelta/ui/SmeltItemCatalog.kt` `src/main/kotlin/inventorydelta/config/InventoryDeltaConfig.kt` `src/main/kotlin/inventorydelta/client/InventoryDeltaClientMod.kt` `src/main/kotlin/inventorydelta/ui/InventoryDeltaModMenuIntegration.kt`: Added Cloth Config screen, Mod Menu hook, keybind to open settings, and per-smelter recipe/fuel pickers backed by JSON persistence with defaults and legacy merge.
- Mod metadata and build - `src/main/resources/fabric.mod.json` `build.gradle.kts`: Declared Fabric 1.21.10 target, Kotlin 2.2.21 toolchain, bundled Cloth Config and Mod Menu dependencies, and wired version expansion.

## Compatibility Notes
- Targets Minecraft 1.21.10 with Fabric Loader 0.18.1, Fabric API 0.138.3, and Fabric Language Kotlin 1.13.7; earlier game versions are unsupported.
- Config file now stores `smeltProfiles` per smelter and normalizes invalid or blank entries; legacy `ingredientId` and `fuelId` fields are migrated on load.
- AutoSmelt will populate empty or matching smelter slots on GUI open; it will not replace different items but will consume matching inventory stacks automatically.

releases.notes:
# Release Receipt:
## Current Features
######   > AutoTradeSlot Delta: Refills villager/wandering trader input slots after each trade using player inventory; respects manual slots and rapid trades; mixin on `TradeOutputSlot` tails into Kotlin logic.
######   > AutoCraftSlot Delta: After crafting, refills the crafting grid using the pre-craft layout from player inventory; ignores mismatched manual placements; mixin on `CraftingResultSlot` heads/tails into Kotlin logic.
######   > Settings UI: Cloth Config screen listing Delta toggles; accessible via Mod Menu integration and client keybind (`K` by default, category Inventory).
## Dependencies
######   > Cloth Config Fabric 20.0.149
######   > Mod Menu 16.0.0-rc.1
